name: Garlic Prawn & Salmon Smash
notes:
Buttery gochugaru prawns, hot smoked salmon and creamy avocado smashed with crisp cucumber and peas, piled high on toasted sourdough.

Ingredients (whole batch):
For the prawns:
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp butter
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 red chillies
• 1 tbsp gochugaru
• 200g king prawns
• 1 lemon
For the rest:
• 2 hot smoked salmon fillets
• 100g petit pois
• 100g edamame
• 3 spring onions
• ½ cucumber
• 2 tbsp light mayonnaise
• 1 tbsp sesame seeds
• 1 avocado
To serve:
• 4 slices sourdough
• 1 tsp sesame seeds
• Salt
• Black pepper

Method:
1. Finely slice the garlic and chillies. Zest and juice the lemon.
2. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Once foaming, add the garlic, chillies and gochugaru and cook for 2–3 mins until soft. Add the prawns and cook for 90 seconds each side until pink all the way through, then finish with the lemon zest and juice and season. Set aside.
3. Skin the salmon and add it to a large bowl with the petit pois, edamame, sliced spring onions, light mayo, sesame seeds, prawns and cucumber. Smash with a pizza cutter until evenly cut and combined. Cut the avocado into large chunks and fold through. Season.
4. Toast the sourdough, pile the smash on top and finish with a drizzle of chilli oil and a scatter of sesame seeds.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 6g, fibre 8g, sugars 7g, sodium 1136mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/garlic-prawn-salmon-high-protein-smash
